content:
maria: Heads-up - rack-r17 node gpu1 started spitting Xid 43 ECC on 2026-03-18 09:12 UTC. Dropped perf and then kernel marked as flaky, I drained it.

maria: Relevant lines from dmesg:```
[ 12345.678901] NVRM: Xid (PCI:0000:65:00): 43, N: 0, Ch: 00000000, GPU has fallen off the bus
[ 12345.679012] NVRM: GPU 0000:65:00:00: Attempted to end but failed
```

maria: Serial on the card is S/N: MXT1234567890, install tag rack-r17-gpu1, warranty shows vendor RMA eligible. Need spare swap & RMA ticket.

raj: thanks — I'll claim a spare from spare-pool-3. Can someone confirm if we should swap in-place or depot-swap?

kevin: In-place swap is fine if spares are pre-provisioned. We prefer depot swap if the card has recurring ECC flakiness because vendor wants to inspect. This looks like recurring memory ECC -> do RMA with depot.

maria: agreed. I drained with `rehydratectl drain rack-r17-gpu1 --grace 300` and moved workloads off. Node is in maintenance.

raj: grabbing spare now. inventoryctl allocate --pool spare-pool-3 --label "rack-r17-replace" --serial placeholder
raj: copying steps for onsite tech: 1) `poweroff rack-r17-node1` 2) remove gpu module (see ops runbook) 3) insert spare S/N: SPARE-MX-092 4) poweron and run `nvme-firmware-check && nvidia-smi -q | grep -A2 'Ecc Errors'`

maria: tagging spare in ticket when it goes in. Please also update `fleet/inventory.csv`.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: node rack-r17-node1 set to maintenance by maria at 2026-03-18T09:20:11Z :wrench: (reason: ECC Xid failures)

nvidia-rma-bot: Ticket NV-1002187 created (RMA type: depot swap). Depot: AMS-W, vendor contact: ops-eu@vendor.example, ETA parts: 3-5 business days. RMA status: awaiting approval.

kevin: ping vendor for customs paperwork. AMS depot has had a 24-48h customs hold recently for units flagged as cross-border. If the card is marked for export, add HS code and COO.

maria: confirmed HS code 8473.30. Invoice attached in ticket (I uploaded a redacted copy).

raj: swap complete, spare inserted. Quick check: `nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,serial,ecc.errors.corrected.volatile --format=csv` output:```
index, name, serial, ecc_errors_corrected_volatile
0, A100-40GB, SPARE-MX-092, 0
```

raj: marking old card serial MXT1234567890 as RMA in inventory and setting spare serial in the node.

maria: thanks. Can you also note in the ticket that we swapped in a spare with serial SPARE-MX-092 and request a test return label?

nvidia-rma-bot: Vendor update: RMA NV-1002187 approved. Return label to be issued once we confirm pickup window. Estimated pickup: 2026-03-23 to 2026-03-25.

kevin: FYI finance — this will be charged to the eng-infra RMA pool (GL: INFRA-RMA). sylvie, does that impact spare replacement budgeting?

sylvie: It will be drawn from RMA budget. If we cross >10 RMAs in a month we trigger a review. One card doesn't change burn but flagging for trend if more in AMS region.

maria: note for follow-up: run extended memtest on spare after 24h of traffic (see runbook). Set alert to monitor `ecc.corrected.total` and `gpu_reboots` for 72h.

raj: I added the replacement to the node's metadata: `gpu_serial=SPARE-MX-092, previous_serial=MXT1234567890, rma_ticket=NV-1002187`.

maria: tagging @kevin for vendor escalation if pickup slips. Also will create a short postmortem if we see another ECC on same rack within 7 days.

kevin: ack. If vendor requests depot swap proof, attach `dmesg` snippet + `nvidia-smi -q` output.

sylvie: Inventory update done. Also updated spare pool counts: spare-pool-3 now 12 -> 11.

maria: closing loop: node back to service, monitoring in-progress. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
